build_siren_network: build a Siren neural network with sine activations using a config object for depth and hidden channels
create_sine_layer: create a SineLayer with custom omega_0 frequency factor for first or hidden layer weight initialization
run_sine_layer_forward: run forward pass through a SineLayer to compute sin(omega_0 * linear(input)) output
review_siren_forward_with_skip: review the Siren forward pass that concatenates skip connections at specified layer indices
test_sine_layer_intermediate: test the SineLayer forward_with_intermediate method to inspect pre-sine activation distributions
